title: HostlistDirectory database entry
description: One list. Lives at database/<format>/<author>/<list>.json. Values found in the list's own header win over the plain fields here; 'overrides' win over everything.

author.description: Display author. Defaults to the author folder name.

description.description: Fallback description, used when the list header has none.

license.description: Licence (SPDX id where possible). Beats the header, which often only links to a LICENSE file.

alternativeMirrors.description: Tried in order when the main mirror fails.

enabled.description: false keeps the file but leaves the list out of Directory.json.

notes.description: Short caveat shown to users, e.g. 'Aggressive: may block some legitimate sites.'

overrides.description: Forced values that ignore the list header.

patterns.description: Custom regexes per field for headers the generic parser can't read. Applied per line to the first 1000 lines; capture group 1 is the value.

detectionMethods.description: Deprecated v1 format. Still read: user-specified becomes an override, text-locate/regex becomes a pattern.
